snippet.title: Railway Station Ki Veg Biryani… Naale Ke Paas Ban Rahi Hai?! 😳
snippet.description:
Railway station par veg biryani khareedi.

Lekin agar woh food unhygienic jagah par prepare ho raha ho toh?

Food safety ka sawaal sirf taste ka nahi hai.

Ingredients kahan store hue, paani kaisa tha, food kis surface par prepare hua aur seller hygiene maintain kar raha hai ya nahi — sab matter karta hai.

🍎 APPLE WAX

Apple ko rub karne par wax dikhna automatically adulteration prove nahi karta.

Apples naturally protective wax banate hain, aur FSSAI permitted food-grade coatings such as beeswax, carnauba wax and shellac ko allow karta hai when regulations and labelling are followed.

Problem non-permitted wax hai — every wax coating nahi. (Digital Sansad)

🏫 SCHOOL MID-DAY MEALS

South Korea ke school-meal standards energy, protein, carbohydrates, fats, vitamins and minerals ke defined nutritional ranges follow karte hain. Nutritionists meals plan karte hain. (bogun.sen.go.kr)

West Bengal mein 2026 mein Kolkata school meals ke vegetarianisation ko lekar controversy hui after ISKCON-linked meals initially removed eggs and proposed alternatives like paneer, rajma and soy.

Important update: criticism ke baad government later decided eggs would be provided separately. (The Indian Express)

🥤 GLUCON-D VS HOMEMADE NIMBU PAANI

Current Glucon-D Nimbu Pani listings show roughly:

92 g total sugar per 100 g
92 g added sugar per 100 g

So yes, sugar forms most of the powder by weight. (BigBasket)

But saying homemade lemon water automatically gives exactly 5 times more Vitamin C depends on how much fresh lemon you actually use.

Fresh lemon water can be a simple low-cost drink, but Glucon-D is mainly designed as a glucose-based energy product — they are not identical products.

🔥 ROTI DIRECT FLAME PAR?

Very heavily charring starchy foods can increase compounds such as acrylamide and some direct-flame cooking methods can increase PAHs.

But current evidence does NOT support saying that briefly puffing a roti on a clean gas flame automatically gives you cancer.

The stronger advice is:

Avoid repeatedly burning or heavily charring food.

Direct flame for a few seconds is not the same as eating blackened food every day. (PubMed)

🥛 MILK WATER TEST

This home test is actually from FSSAI.

Put a drop of milk on a polished slanting surface.

Pure milk should stay or move slowly while leaving a white trail.

Milk diluted with water may flow quickly without leaving a trail. (Eat Right India)

Important:

This is a screening test for added water.

It does NOT prove the milk is completely pure from every possible adulterant.

Also, don’t beat your milkman 😂

If you suspect adulteration, preserve the sample and complain through the proper food-safety channel.

BOTTOM LINE:

Street food ho.
Apple ho.
Health drink ho.
Milk ho.

One rule:

HYGIENE DEKHO.
LABEL PADHO.
HOME TEST KO LAB REPORT MAT BANAO.

Aap railway/station food khate waqt hygiene check karte ho?

YES / NO comment karo 👇

Share this with your frequent-traveller friend.

#FoodSafety #RailwayFood #ConsumerAwareness

This recipe is especially prepared for the Kartik Masam, following a no-onion and no-garlic cooking style. It is simple, nutritious and packed with plant-based protein. Soya chunks and besan provide protein, while curd and vegetables add flavour and make this a wholesome breakfast option.

The best part? You don’t need any complicated ingredients or elaborate preparation. Just blend, mix, spread and cook! ❤️

1. Boil the soya chunks until soft.
2. Drain and squeeze out all the excess water.
3. Grind the soya chunks into a coarse, powder-like consistency.
4. Transfer to a bowl and add besan, curd, grated carrot, ginger, green chillies, coriander leaves and salt.
5. Add water gradually and mix everything into a smooth, spreadable batter.
6. Heat a pan and lightly grease it with oil.
7. Pour the batter and spread it like a dosa or chilla.
8. Cook on a low flame until one side is cooked, then flip and cook the other side.
9. Serve hot and enjoy your protein-rich breakfast!

Note: We are not using onion or garlic because this recipe is specially prepared for Kartik Masam. If you’re making it on regular days, you can add finely chopped onions too.

snippet.title: How a Corpse Becomes a Vampire 🧛
snippet.description:
You dig up a chubby corpse... so you build a vampire, one problem at a time. A wooden stake, a sickle on his neck, a padlock on his toe, poppy seeds he has to count, a Count's castle, a black cape with a giant collar and the fangs Bela Lugosi never had.
Based on the real vampire reports: in 1725 and 1732, Austrian officials in Serbian villages wrote down dug-up corpses that looked plump, red and fresh (today we call it ordinary decay), and the villagers drove stakes through them; a woman buried in Pień, Poland, dug up in 2022, had a sickle across her neck and a padlock on her toe; in Bram Stoker's Dracula (1897) the Count walks around London by day, and the sunlight that kills him first appears in the film Nosferatu (1922); the 1924 stage play gave him evening dress and the high-collared cape, and Lugosi's 1931 Dracula has no fangs.

snippet.title: Esse óleo parece asfalto e move navios 🛢️
snippet.description:
Esse combustível tem vários nomes: óleo combustível pesado, HFO na sigla em inglês, ou bunker, que vem do nome dos depósitos de carvão dos antigos navios a vapor. Uma das versões mais comuns é o IFO 380, em que o número indica a viscosidade: 380 centistokes a 50°C, centenas de vezes mais grosso que o diesel comum. 🛢️

O primeiro navio oceânico movido a motor diesel foi o dinamarquês Selandia, construído pelo estaleiro Burmeister & Wain e lançado em 1912. Ele usava a tecnologia criada pelo engenheiro alemão Rudolf Diesel, que apresentou o primeiro motor funcional em 1897. Em poucas décadas, o diesel substituiu o carvão e o vapor na maioria dos cargueiros. 🚢

Um dos maiores motores do mundo é o Wärtsilä-Sulzer RTA96-C, usado em navios como o Emma Mærsk, lançado em 2006. A versão de 14 cilindros pesa mais de 2 mil toneladas, tem a altura de um prédio de uns 4 andares e passa dos 100 mil cavalos de potência, girando a no máximo uns 100 rotações por minuto. ⚙️

Esses motores gigantes de dois tempos estão entre as máquinas térmicas mais eficientes já feitas, aproveitando mais de 50% da energia do combustível. Um motor de carro comum costuma ficar perto de 30% a 40%. 📊

A poluição levou a regras mais rígidas. Desde 1º de janeiro de 2020, a Organização Marítima Internacional limita o enxofre do combustível a 0,5%, contra 3,5% antes. Pra continuar usando o óleo pesado, muitos navios instalaram lavadores de gases, chamados scrubbers, que tiram parte do enxofre da fumaça antes dela sair pela chaminé. 🌍

Em algumas regiões, a regra é ainda mais dura. No Mar do Norte, no Báltico, na costa da América do Norte e no Mediterrâneo, que entrou na lista em 2025, o limite é de só 0,1% de enxofre. No Ártico, o óleo pesado foi proibido a partir de julho de 2024, com algumas exceções até 2029. 🧭

O setor também já testa combustíveis alternativos. Em 2023, a Maersk colocou no mar o Laura Maersk, o primeiro porta-contêineres do mundo capaz de navegar com metanol verde. 🌱

#navios #engenharia #curiosidades
